description: Website URL discovery and sitemap mapper. Discovers and maps internal URLs across a website using robots.txt, XML sitemaps (including nested sitemap indexes), and HTML links, with optional search filtering and subdomain support.

include_subdomains.description: Include URLs on subdomains of the base domain.
include_subdomains.title: Include Subdomains

max_urls.description: Maximum number of URLs returned (1 to 500).
max_urls.title: Max Urls

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter for discovered URLs.
search.title: Search

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS website URL to map.
url.title: Url

name: map_website
